analysis.description: Opening subject and answer statements only, manually transcribed from the score and checked against Foster's discussion. The rest of the fugue is not represented.

notes: The initial quarter and eighth rests are retained in the incipit. This map includes subject and answer statements only: Foster also identifies a recurring countersubject in mm. 3–4 and 6–7, which is not plotted. The excerpt includes the final subject note after the exposition cadence at m. 8. Manual score transcription of opening subject and answer statements, checked against Dorothy Nell Foster (1973), Chapter IV. Quarter-note units; entry ends include the final note and all its written ties. Excerpts extend through the final subject release when it passes the exposition cadence. No recording timing has been estimated. A short independently engraved subject incipit is included; the source score, thesis prose and chart images are not redistributed.
